_comment: 过场动作 (过场演出 B; DECISIONS「过场动作」): how a scene's actions and shots (SceneCue: a step's `do`, `shot`, `fx`) are timed and framed. Positions are the 2D map's (a walk moves the body); poses, the flying thing and the camera are the picture only. Off with the feel's scene_action_ms at 0 (the suites). seconds: each word's time in units of scene_action_ms (a walk takes what its way takes at walk_speed).

seconds._comment: face: the turn; bow: down, held, up; kneel / rise / draw / sheathe / fall: into (or out of) the pose, which then stays; startle: the hop; shiver / reach: how long it lasts (with `hold`: until that person's next action); hand / toss: the reach, the flight and the catch together; step_back: the step; emerge: rising out of the ground; dissolve: thinning away.

flight._comment: A thing handed or tossed: it leaves the giver's hand at `from` of the action and is in the other's at `to`; rise how high a toss arcs over the straight line (units), a hand none; size / colour the thing shown when its item has no look of its own; glint: a bright chip that flies with it, so a dark thing is seen in a dark room ("": none).

emerge._comment: One rising out of the ground: depth how far under it begins (units).

dissolve._comment: One thinning away where it stands: it sinks and narrows to nothing while a puff of `art` (BattleArts) in `colour` rises, `scale` times the fight's size.

shots._comment: near / look: the camera's push-in (a share of the map's own framing; 1 = as the map frames itself); two: both figures kept inside `two_fill` of the picture's width, never nearer than `two_min`; wide: the map's own framing over the room's middle. seconds: how long the push takes. move: pan (the camera travels there) or cut (it is there at once).

light._comment: A soft light over what a shot looks at, so who acts is seen in a dark room: on while a shot is in force (near, two, look; not wide), eased in and out over `seconds`; energy 0: none. Not on 画质 低 without the fight's lights.
